company.name: Leadbay
company.shortDescription: Leadbay is a developer of AI-powered B2B sales platform discovering and qualifying high-potential SMB leads automatically.
company.description: Leadbay develops AI software for B2B lead discovery and sales prospecting. The company provides tools for identifying, qualifying, and scoring small and medium-sized businesses using data enrichment, predictive models, and workflow integrations. Its platform supports sales teams with prospecting automation, contact discovery, CRM synchronization, and lead prioritization based on business signals and market data.

productsAndServices.description: An AI model that predicts future top B2B clients and generates new qualified leads within a company's ideal customer profile.
